8258.title: Disposed tunnel sessions still dispatch incoming frames
8258.rootCauseOneLine: Session disposal leaves socket message listeners attached, so late frames still invoke the retired Connect origin resolver.
8258.proposedFix: Unregister only the session-owned message and close handlers before aborting its streams; real-WebSocket regressions verify disposal blocks late HTTP and WebSocket work.
8258.caveats: Lifecycle defect reproduced twice on trusted main. Actual plugin API invalidation and whole-server restart were not executed; current main contains stale plugin errors. Full monorepo build hit unrelated unresolved SDK runtime imports; relevant tests and typechecks passed.
